thread:
Noah (CS): Kicking off Aurora private/VPC onboarding. Quick list of open items from preflight: egress firewall ranges, SA permissions for model pulls, KMS key ACL and rotation plan, and audit logs to Splunk with mTLS. @Sam can you pick up SA + firewall questions? :wave:
Sam (Eng-Infra): Happy to. What SA name is Aurora provisioning? Also confirm whether model artifacts live in GCS or S3 so I can set storage roles.
DevOps (Aurora): Well create `aurora-rw-svc` in project `aurora-prod`. Model bucket is GCS `gs://aurora-models-prod`. Need read-only pull for runtime.
Sam (Eng-Infra): Ok, will plan to grant `roles/storage.objectViewer` and `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` on the SA. Any restrictions on key usage timing for KMS rotation?
Lina (Security): Rotation cadence per contract is quarterly. KMS key must include binding: `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` to Redwood SA and `roles/cloudkms.viewer` to aurora-security@aurora.example.com. Also need an audit-only log sink to their Splunk endpoint.
Noah (CS): Lina, can you paste a minimal policy snippet we can hand to the customer?
Lina (Security): Sure. Snippet to apply to key ring:
```json
{"bindings":[{"role":"roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter","members":["serviceAccount:aurora-rw-svc@aurora-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com","serviceAccount:redwood-inference@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]},{"role":"roles/cloudkms.viewer","members":["group:aurora-security@aurora.example.com"]}]}
```
Carlos (SRE): For audit ingestion: we require mTLS client certs from Aurora and TLS1.2+. Endpoint URL? Also sample event payload to validate mapping.
DevOps (Aurora): Endpoint: `https://splunk.ingest.aurora.example/services/collector`. We can provide certs. Sample event (JSON):
```json
{"timestamp":"2026-03-01T15:04:05Z","service":"redwood-agent","level":"INFO","event":{"type":"model.pull","model":"rw-7b","status":"success","bytes":124578}}
```
Sam (Eng-Infra): Firewall egress ranges we need whitelisted for runtime and health checks: `35.196.0.0/14`, `34.120.0.0/14`. Ports 443 and 15002 (metrics). Deploy-bot, note runbook link?
deploy-bot: Runbook created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/aurora-week0 - include onboarding checklist and KMS rotation doc.
Lina (Security): Also require HMAC header X-Event-Signature for integrity with shared secret. Aurora, can you add HMAC-SHA256 signing on events?
DevOps (Aurora): Yes, we can sign events. We'll post the shared secret to the secure handoff doc only.
Noah (CS): Summary actions: 1) DevOps to create SA and upload certs + sample events; 2) Sam to apply storage and SA roles after SA exists and confirm firewall whitelists; 3) Lina to finalize KMS policy and rotation schedule; 4) Carlos to validate Splunk ingestion and schema. Target: EOD tomorrow PST. Any concerns? :thumbsup:
Carlos (SRE): :thumbsup: Ill spin a validation endpoint in staging and ping here once good. Please DM sample payload to #support-telemetry if you can't attach here.
Noah (CS): Great — I'll update the runbook with owners/ETAs and loop back in morning. Thanks all.
